The bundled script generates an official Windows 11 x64 ISO link through unelevated Windows PowerShell. No updater, execution-policy bypass or runtime script download is provided. Microsoft may block link generation; the manual Microsoft-page alternative remains available. Native WinISOPilot independently validates the returned URL and handles the transfer.
